notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.
